image.build_notes: Built on the isolated bench daemon (unix:///data/docker-bench/docker.sock) with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, --network host). VLLM_REPOSITORY was overridden to a local git-daemon (git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git) serving the full, content-verified upstream vLLM history, because the bench host's only github egress (proxy) EOFs on the large history pack. Provenance is asserted by content in-image (HEAD==base_commit, tree match, rev-list>1, not shallow, oracle absent, clean tree) and verified post-build via task_ci.py image-check. codeload + files.pythonhosted.org fetched directly.

freeze.scope: final executable files; final Oracle has exact matching bytes

statement.summary: Compact prose; behavior and performance requirements retained.

environment.summary: Base, image recipe and cutoff unchanged. Prior provenance retained; runtime image ID and agent-user CUDA canary checked by each Harbor run.

verifier.summary: The production factory now constructs the actual modular wrapper before the fixture calls its expert kernel. The reference and valid controls use a normal torch.nn.Module wrapper, avoiding an unrelated ambient CustomOp config lookup. The original production-quant-owner candidate remains unchanged as a negative regression control. Config ownership, genuine warnings, workspace extent and numerical output remain independently checked.
